title: PermitRouteLeg
description: Route-only model for ONE permit. A trip is an ordered list of these (one per state permit). Nothing about vehicle, fees or restrictions.

total_miles.description: Only if the permit prints a route total

road.description: Road designation EXACTLY as printed (IH20, SH43, I-20, US-79, CO RD 20). Null for a ramp/exit line with no road named. Never normalise or guess.

exit.description: Exit number if the line gives one

miles.description: Length of this step as printed; null if the permit prints none

kind.description: ramp = exit/ramp line; detour = line inside or introducing a detour; not_permitted = permit itself says route is not authorised there

text.description: The permit's own wording for this step, copied verbatim
Verbatim, e.g. 'IH0020 LA Line' or 'FRINK ST,CAYCE,SC'
